sites.reason: This verification-only recovery diagnostic refuses incomplete immutable apply evidence or a version without a hash-bound named assertion (a catalog contract, or for a data or pg_cron migration an exact row count; issue #4214). It preserves fail-closed validation and does not classify throughput readiness.

This verification-only recovery diagnostic refuses incomplete immutable apply evidence or absent hash-bound named catalog contracts. It preserves fail-closed validation and does not classify throughput readiness.

This verification-only recovery diagnostic refuses a migration without at least one positive, named, exact-SQL-hash-bound assertion. Accompanying exact absence checks cannot alone prove applied behavior; every observed result still must match. It does not classify throughput readiness.
